description: This file declares functions for component management in a software project, including setting and getting parameters, managing instances, and manipulating CSV strings. It also includes licensing information and external dependencies.

methods.name: component_set_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a component.

methods.name: component_set_str_param
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a component.

methods.name: component_set_params
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a component.

methods.name: component_get_path_instance
methods.description: Retrieves the path instance of a component based on a query.

methods.name: component_add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance of a component.

methods.name: component_del_instance
methods.description: Deletes an instance of a component.

methods.name: component_get_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a component.

methods.name: component_add_string_to_csv
methods.description: Adds a string to a CSV parameter of a component.

methods.name: component_remove_string_from_csv
methods.description: Removes a string from a CSV parameter of a component.
